hyperAccuracyReceipt.reviewNotes: Checkpoint 003 is visually inspected learning evidence; keep incoming until hyper-accuracy review and matching rationale pass.
hyperAccuracyReceipt.nonCopyBoundary: Do not copy exact source visuals, brand names, color identity, imagery, icon systems, decorative geometry, or section order.

commercialPurpose: Give editorial or personal-brand templates an about/proof section where the person is the trust asset.
purposeLayer: About section turns author identity into credibility through portrait scale, biography, pull quote, and signature cue.
anatomyLayer: Large portrait image, text column, biography paragraphs, centered quote accent, role label, and signature mark.
hierarchyLayer: Portrait and white space first, biography second, quote third, signature/role cue last.
gridRhythmLayer: Two-column editorial split with oversized image on one side and airy text/quote stack on the other.
densityLimitLayer: Use one primary portrait, 2-4 paragraphs, 1 pull quote, and 1 signature/role cue.
originalityLayer: Learn the portrait-plus-quote proof behavior, not the exact Pallas image, script signature, or gold quote styling.
usageRuleLayer: Use for author, founder, consultant, stylist, chef, educator, and creator credibility sections.
layoutGesture: editorial about portrait paired with quote and signature proof
sectionSilhouette: oversized portrait block beside airy biography column
compositionTension: human image weight balanced by delicate quote and text rhythm
focalPath: portrait to biography to pull quote to signature
negativeSpaceShape: large white editorial field with split-column breathing room
depthLayering: flat image plane plus text/quote hierarchy
moduleScaleVariation: large portrait against small quote and signature details
antiCopyBoundary: Do not copy the exact portrait crop, quote text, signature graphic, logo, or gold accent.
